useCases.label: Meditation Timer
useCases.desc: A free 10-minute meditation timer with a gentle alarm. Set it, close your eyes, and it rings softly when your session ends.
useCases.intro: Set a length for your meditation and press Start. The timer sounds when the session ends, so you can close your eyes without watching the clock.

useCases.label: Study Timer
useCases.desc: A free 50-minute study timer with an alarm. Great for focused study blocks and exam revision. No sign-up.
useCases.intro: Set a study interval and press Start. When it ends, take a break. Change the study time to suit your task and attention span.

useCases.label: Workout Timer
useCases.desc: A free 30-minute workout timer with an alarm. Keep your session on track from warm-up to cool-down.
useCases.intro: Choose a duration for your workout and press Start. The timer sounds when the session ends.

useCases.label: Tea Timer
useCases.desc: A free 4-minute tea steeping timer with an alarm. Brew the perfect cup without over-steeping.
useCases.intro: Set the steeping time recommended for your tea, then press Start when you pour the water.

useCases.label: Boiled Egg Timer
useCases.desc: A free online egg timer with an alarm. Set it for soft, medium or hard-boiled eggs and it rings when they're done.
useCases.intro: Choose a cooking-time preset, adjust it for your method and press Start. The timer tracks the time; egg size and cooking conditions affect the result.

useCases.label: Plank Timer
useCases.desc: A free 2-minute plank timer with an alarm. Hold your plank and let the timer count you down.
useCases.intro: Choose a duration for your plank and press Start. Adjust the time to suit your own routine.

useCases.label: 2-Minute Brushing Timer
useCases.desc: A free 2-minute timer for brushing teeth, with an alarm. Dentists recommend two minutes — perfect for kids and adults.
useCases.intro: This two-minute brushing timer is ready. Press Start and follow the countdown until it rings.
